about_the_game:
A relaxed, lightweight tower defense game set on a conveyor belt sushi restaurant! 🍣🥷🤖
Squids and octopuses flowing down the lane, and even flying puddings!? Dive into an intense tower defense battle against an onslaught of ingredients!
Unique characters drawn with rough, hand-drawn graphics run wild!
Unlock various cards and power-ups as you progress! Enhance your ninja robot, defeat bosses, and gain even more power!

How to Play:

The game consists of a repeating cycle of a Card Purchase Phase and a Sushi Wave Phase. Players need to effectively pick weapons, towers, and cards to build up power against the sushi waves.

Card Purchase & Effect Activation Phase
Purchase cards to increase your stats. Cards activate at the start of each round.
The types of cards available will increase with your Sushi Tier, allowing more cards to activate at once.


Sushi Wave Phase
Defeat sushi and accumulate experience to raise your Sushi Tier.
If you can't handle the enemy's attacks and your HP drops to zero, it's game over. After defeating a certain number of enemies, you'll enter the Purchase Phase.
Ultimately, if you survive until the set time, you clear the game.

Features of "sushininjarobot TD":


  • Unpredictable Gameplay: With different card combinations every time, there are countless ways to win!
  • Simple Gameplay: Control your ninja robot and quickly deal with the flowing sushi. If you keep missing them, it's game over!
  • Easy to Enjoy:Perfect for a quick break!
  • Unique Hand-Drawn Graphics: Graphics created during a bit of free time!
  • Unnecessarily Long Opening:A unique opening sequence only found in this game!

What "sushininjarobot TD" Does NOT Offer:


  • Multiplayer
  • Elaborate puzzle-like level design

Video and Streaming Guidelines

You are allowed to monetize videos and streams without permission, whether you are an individual or a corporation.
